name: One-eye caption glasses with a microphone strip
summary: Everything homemade: the floating screen in front of one eye, and four microphones in a row along the top of the frames. The row is easier to get working than microphones at four corners.
notes: Nobody has built it yet. The direction sums for a row are tested on simulated sound and the firmware builds, but it has not run on a board. A straight row of microphones tells left from right, not ahead from behind. The one-eye screen shows the speaker's number and which side they are on; it cannot float a caption beside them.
